note: Static image built from RDM-ember-osf-web-dev2027 (manifest note; PR #2 review r1 R1-03): nginx-unprivileged as uid 101 on port 4200, read-only root with only /tmp writable. No command: the image's entrypoint renders index.html into /tmp/grdm with the backend URLs below, exits 1 on a value that is not a plain http(s) URL (OSF_COOKIE_DOMAIN: a host name; CSP_MODE: enforce or report-only; CSP_EXTRA_SOURCES, unset here: space-separated http(s) origins), refuses to serve when a placeholder or the Google Analytics adapter is left in the page, writes the Content-Security-Policy from these origins and execs nginx. These are the only variables the image reads. The URLs are the published loopback ports (ADR-02); CAS_URL is fakecas's published port, or web's own origin with --auth shibboleth (osf.io's login route then redirects to the SP). Nothing is built at start, so there is no volume, no depends_on and a 128 MiB floor at weight 0.5 instead of the 8 GiB the former prebuilt image needed to run ember build under emulation. The healthcheck is the image's own (busybox wget; the image has no curl) written out so the Compose file states it; `grdm-dev health` probes /healthz on the published port. web proxies /ember_osf_web/ to this service (PROXY_EMBER_APPS strips the prefix; the image serves both URL spaces).
